leadText:
Halverson (Japanese: ハクア Hakua) is a character of the day who appeared in To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!.

Halverson was one of the participants in the Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament with his . Their first opponent was Jessie, who was partnered with . Halverson and Marowak won by default after Jessie's disqualification and moved on to the second round. They would go on to be defeated by and in the third round.
